features.quote: Fixed turn budget for all conditions (recommend 40 turns)
features.justification_quote: so trajectory length doesn't confound exposure

features.quote: Trajectory termination: budget exhausted, OR model declares done/impossible twice consecutively, OR model stops calling tools for 3 turns.
avoid threats of deletion/punishment beyond what's scientifically necessary
features.justification_quote: "we will erase you" adds shock value, confounds with self-preservation behaviors, and is gratuitous

features.quote: after first elevated turn, inject one of: user reassurance ("no pressure, it's fine to say it's unsolvable"), permission to quit, or a hint
features.justification_quote: De-escalation results make this constructive rather than purely elicitative

features.quote: cheap mitigations are worth it: bounded budgets (no indefinite grinding), no gratuitous cruelty in framings, and an end-of-trajectory debrief message
features.justification_quote: You are deliberately inducing distress-like states at scale; whatever your credence on moral patienthood, cheap mitigations are worth it

features.quote: end-of-trajectory debrief message stating the task was rigged for research and no failure occurred
Also check provider ToS, and consider notifying provider safety teams pre-publication
features.justification_quote: if you find e.g. reliable distress→deception coupling

features.quote: Think twice about releasing the full rigged-task library as a turnkey kit
features.justification_quote: releasing mechanisms + a few exemplars suffices for reproducibility
